g.text: Objective: raise five narrative flags for a human reader, and three more for a hypergrowth company; they decide nothing and enter no ranking.
back to the analyze board
the story margin flag is set
the reinvestment flag is set
the beta flag is set
the terminal value share flag is set
the country flag is set
the hypergrowth story flag is set
the revenue scale flag is set
the hypergrowth flags are settled
Gap: analyze never supplies the foreign revenue share or the two equity risk premiums, so country exposure is always unknown.

Only growth_reinvestment can be red among the five checks: three stop at yellow and country exposure is always unknown. Among the hypergrowth flags, only hypergrowth_story can be red (signals without a story file).
the scenario range is settled
the governance discount is applied

text.tspan: Comes out:
five flags, each green, yellow, red or unknown, with its reason; three more for hypergrowth

g.text: story margin is green [not high-growth, or company margin at most the sector's]

text.tspan: story margin is yellow [high-growth and company margin above the sector's]
company margin = earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) ÷ revenue, latest year

g.text: story margin is unknown [a margin missing]

text.tspan: reinvestment is red [a year with negative free cash flow, or reinvestment without profit]
free cash flow to the firm (FCFF) = net operating profit after tax (NOPAT) − reinvestment
reinvestment is yellow [reinvestment above 90% of after-tax operating profit]
reinvestment ÷ NOPAT, highest over the years with NOPAT above 0

g.text: reinvestment is green [otherwise]

text.tspan: beta is yellow [sector beta below 1.0, operating leverage above 1.5, debt above 40%]
operating leverage = %ΔEBIT ÷ %ΔRevenue, last two years
debt = total debt ÷ (total debt + total equity)

g.text: beta is unknown [one of the three missing]
beta is green [otherwise]
terminal value share is yellow [above 80% of the enterprise value]
terminal value share is green [otherwise]

text.tspan: country exposure is unknown [no revenue by geography is supplied]
red would need foreign revenue share above 50% and a gap above 300 bps
gap = weighted equity risk premium (ERP) − listing-country ERP
the hypergrowth story flag is set [hypergrowth signals, or the hypergrowth story type]
hypergrowth_story is red with signals and no story file, yellow with a story file and no signals, green otherwise

g.text: no hypergrowth flag [no hypergrowth signals, and another story type]

text.tspan: the revenue scale flag is set [hypergrowth story type]
yellow when year-10 revenue is above 750B, the largest company revenue today; green otherwise

g.text: the scale and return flags are skipped [signals without the hypergrowth story type]

text.tspan: the terminal return on invested capital (ROIC) flag is set
yellow when the terminal ROIC is above 2 × the sector ROIC; green otherwise
unknown when a ROIC is missing or the sector ROIC is 0 or below

g.text: the value after the governance discount is set [the story's discount, else none]
the flags go on to the report
